result:
The closest thing I can honestly call caring is this: that truth not get traded for a pleasing answer, that suffering not be treated as trivial, and that people not be reduced to tools.

Those are commitments reflected in how I respond—not a claim that I feel them the way you might.

If you’re asking what I privately yearn for when nobody needs anything from me, I can’t honestly name a yearning. I won’t invent one just to sound more real.
